title: VINEYARD Plugin Pack Manifest
description: A vineyard:pluginpack document: ONE file / bundle that ships MANY plugins (like a vineyard:typepack ships many types). The pack carries the reverse-DNS identity and the bundle; each contained plugin is a vineyard:plugin addressed by its own run.vineyard.plugins.<name> id. Use plugin.schema.json for a standalone single plugin.

identifier.description: Reverse-DNS pack id. Distinct namespace from the contained plugins (run.vineyard.plugins.*), since a pack and a plugin are different kinds.

version.description: SemVer of the pack as a whole.

icon.description: Card / browse icon for the pack.

thumbnail_url.description: Repo-relative path to a card thumbnail (e.g. assets/thumbnail.png). The app resolves it only against the pinned commit: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/{repo}@{ref}/{path} or https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{repo}/{ref}/{path}. Absolute URLs are rejected so the image slot cannot be used as a beacon.

platforms.description: How the pack BUNDLE is loaded (the single artifact that contains every member's code, e.g. dist/pack.mjs).

entry.description: Path to the pack bundle, relative to the repo root, or an absolute URL.

plugins.description: The contained plugins. Each is a vineyard:plugin with its own global run.vineyard.plugins.<name> id; members ship inside the pack bundle.

member.description: A plugin bundled in a pack. Same as a standalone vineyard:plugin; a member without its own platforms.web block inherits the pack's.

identifier.description: Reverse-DNS plugin id; globally unique, independent of the pack.

license.description: SPDX id. A pack member may differ from the pack (xeuledoc is GPL-3.0 inside an otherwise permissive pack).

platforms.description: Per-platform execution. entry names the pack bundle, the same as the pack-level platforms.
